name: XHToken Spark-X2.6-4B model card (README.md + images/all_benchmark.svg comparison table)
notes: First-party model card for Spark-X2.6-4B, read 2026-10-21. README.md gives architecture prose, the thinking-level story (none/low/high) and serving recipes; the benchmark numbers live ONLY in two SVG figures, images/all_benchmark.svg (full 27-row table, 6 model columns) and images/benchmark.svg (8-bar chart subset) - the markdown README contains no benchmark table at all, so a card-text-only read would wrongly conclude 'no published benchmarks'. Numbers were extracted from the SVG text nodes; the file carries a matplotlib render timestamp of 2026-10-21T00:39:26. Card footnote legend, verbatim: '* denotes reported results from publicly-released model cards / papers and - denotes scores not yet available'. Sampling: temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=-1. Gaokao 2026 dataset published at https://huggingface.co/datasets/XHToken/gaokao_math_2026. Vendor-published throughout, no third-party reproduction. Architecture config read from the repo's own config.json (architectures Spark2_5ForCausalLM, model_type spark2_5, trust_remote_code required).
